Subject: Post-call: Security & Incident Response follow-up (SOC 2, BCP/DR evidence)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side so your security and compliance teams have what they need to continue evaluation: 

Summary of ask from call:
- Confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and provide the redacted report.
- Provide high-level incident response (IR) timelines and breach notification commitments (GDPR/HIPAA considerations).
- Share BCP/DR evidence (recent DR test report / runbook) and point of contact for IR.
- Start the vendor security questionnaire (attached) so we can capture any control gaps.

What I'm attaching:
- Vendor_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx (worksheet with standard InfoSec + privacy items)
- SOC2_Type2_Redacted.pdf (redacted cover & report stub) — we will send the full auditor cover page under NDA if needed.

High-level IR & notification commitments:
- In scope incidents impacting customer data: Redwood aims to notify customers within 72 hours of confirmation (we typically provide an initial notification within 24-48 hours when there is high confidence and additional details in follow-ups).
- We will provide our Incident Response Playbook (redacted) and latest tabletop/DR test summaries as evidence — target delivery by EOD Thu, Apr 9 (5 business days).

Next steps / owner list: 
- Jordan (me): send redacted SOC2 + IR playbook and a completed vendor questionnaire (today).
- Marissa (Security liaison): will coordinate with our security ops team to provide DR test evidence and confirm notification SLAs.
- Samir / FintechCorp: please review attached questionnaire and flag any follow-up items or additional evidence you need; propose a security deep-dive next week if helpful.

If you want a shorter session focused just on IR/BCP we can set a 30-min slot — available Tue/Wed next week in the afternoon PT.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fintechcorp.com>, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & Incident Response follow-up (SOC 2, BCP/DR evidence)

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap and attachments. A few clarifying questions from our security and legal teams before we loop in procurement: 

1) Breach notification timing — can you confirm Redwood's policy: is the 72-hour window measured from detection or confirmation? For GDPR we need confirmation of the detection -> notification flow.
2) Do you have a formal SLA or contractual clause around customer notification timeframes? If so, please point me to the DPA / contract language (we can review during procurement).
3) For HIPAA scopes (we may limit the POC to PHI-free initially) — do you support Business Associate Agreement (BAA)?
4) For DR evidence: would you be able to provide recent tabletop test dates and an executive summary (not necessarily raw logs)? Our auditors prefer showing a DR test in the last 12 months.

I've attached our initial security questionnaire (redacted), and I'll start feeding answers back into your spreadsheet. We may request a short technical deep-dive on IR process with your security ops team. Can Marissa or Laura be the point people?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Desai
Head of Security Operations | FintechCorp
samir.desai@fintechcorp.com

Attachment: FintechCorp_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir.desai@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & Incident Response follow-up (SOC 2, BCP/DR evidence)

Samir —

Thanks — answers inline and next steps below.

1) Notification timing: our policy is to begin customer notifications based on confirmation of impact (i.e., verified material impact to customer data). Detection-to-confirmation timelines vary; we commit to an initial customer notification within 72 hours of confirmation. Operationally, for incidents where we have high confidence (clear compromise indicators), we typically send an initial notification within 24-48 hours and follow with updates. We will provide the exact DPA/contract clause you referenced — I'll have Legal produce the language for procurement.

2) Contractual commitments: we do include incident notification obligations in our DPA for enterprise customers (we can share a template once procurement requests). If you need a hard SLA for notification timing, we can discuss in the commercial review.

3) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workflows under a BAA; we have customers on BAAs today. If FintechCorp expects PHI handling, we'll route to our compliance team and procurement to finalize the BAA.

4) DR evidence: we can provide a DR tabletop summary (date, scope, outcomes) and a redacted DR test report showing recovery objectives and results. Target: provide the redacted test summary and playbook by EOD Thu, Apr 9. If you need earlier, we can prioritize — let us know.

Attachment: SOC2_Type2_Redacted.pdf, Incident_Response_Playbook_Redwood.pdf (redacted) — see attached.

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan: upload the questionnaire answers into your sheet and share a DocuSign for DPA (today).
- Marissa / Laura: security ops will prepare DR summary & tabletop dates (target Apr 9).
- Samir / FintechCorp: confirm availability for a 30-min IR deep-dive next Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Looping in Rishi from Solutions (to help schedule the deep-dive and handle any architecture questions).
